children: Advantest (ATEYY) climbed 4.56% to 27,195 yen at the November 18 regular-session close in Tokyo, providing the largest lift to the Nikkei after Nvidia's quarterly beat. The Japanese maker of semiconductor test equipment outperformed a weak market: the Nikkei rose only 0.28% to 59,024.28, the Topix fell 0.42%, and about 71% of Prime-market stocks declined.

Nvidia's results showed data center revenue of $107.6 billion, up 110%, and guidance of $130 billion for the January quarter. Every additional AI accelerator and high-bandwidth memory stack must be tested before shipment, which ties test-equipment demand to unit volumes rather than prices. Reuters noted that doubts about data center investment and Nvidia's leadership still capped Tokyo's gains.

GuruFocus gives Advantest a GF Score of 96/100, reflecting elite profitability, a strong balance sheet and good momentum. Its GF Value of 23,034.67 yen sits about 15% below the closing price, so the shares trade at an 18% premium to the model and GuruFocus rates them modestly overvalued at about 34.5 times earnings. That premium leaves little room if AI chip volumes pause. The next measurable test is Advantest's next quarterly order intake, which should show whether Nvidia's higher guide is reaching the tester floor.

title: Advantest Stocks Rise 4.56% in Tokyo as Nvidia's Outlook Lifts Chip Testers
